description: List supporters, newest first, optionally narrowed by status or by date. Use this for history and for questions about a particular period; use list_pending_supports for the approval queue.

from.description: Only from this date onward, as YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: claimed means waiting for the creator to approve.

to.description: Only up to this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: list_supports

code.description: The four-character reference in the payment note. Absent for counter QR payments.

flagged.description: The word filter flagged the message. It is not blocked.

reply.description: The public thank-you the creator wrote.

source.description: Which link or surface it came from.

supporterName.description: Absent when they chose to stay anonymous.
